title: Matthew 7:7
paragraphs: “Ask, and it shall be given you; seek, and ye shall find; knock, and it shall be opened unto you.” (KJV)
Brother, this is Jesus inviting you to come near with bold faith.

Seek.
Pursue God, not just answers.

Knock.
Do not quit when the door feels silent.

This verse is not a blank check for fleshly desires. It is a call to persistent dependence on the Father. Jesus is teaching that God is not annoyed by sincere prayer. He welcomes it. He responds in wisdom, love, and perfect timing.
And here is the deeper beauty: the greatest answer God gives is not merely things.

In Christ, the door to mercy is already open. Through Jesus, sinners can ask for forgiveness, seek truth, and find life. That is the Gospel heartbeat of this verse. We do not come because we are worthy. We come because Christ made a way.
So if your heart is tired today, do not back away.

Ask again.
Seek again.
Knock again.

Prayer:
Lord, teach me to ask with faith, seek with hunger, and knock with perseverance. Let my heart want You more than anything else. In Jesus’ name, amen.
